svg.title: Price the Package Without Hiding the Boundary
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-retainer-package-boundaries; chapter number: 4; title: Price the Package Without Hiding the Boundary; subtitle: Compare quoted commercial components while keeping setup fees separate from recurring service.; caption: Sean Standberry proposes an avatar and conversion-system package; Agency Stack Guide illustrates a managed newsletter; Brett Malinowski describes a bounded design subscription.; assumptions note: Sean Standberry's setup and monthly fees belong to the same example package. Agency Stack Guide and Brett Malinowski describe separate offers. Equal endpoints preserve quoted amounts, not estimated ranges. These buckets are not additive costs or a shared revenue mix.; note: Sean Standberry — 5558JLgLk50 at 00:11:13; Agency Stack Guide — raRxPWQp8ao, including newsletter quality checks at 00:04:59; Brett Malinowski — vBXCdVHBK3o at 00:00:48. Liam Ottley separately recommends estimating maintenance labor before pricing — kgE01J875dY at 00:18:22.; chart type: stacked_comparison; total range: Separate USD quotes; one-time and monthly amounts must not be stacked into a shared total.; buckets: label: Standberry system setup; low: 500; high: 500; notes: $500 one-time setup for landing pages, calendar integration, automation sequences, and CRM.; label: Standberry recurring delivery; low: 1000; high: 1000; notes: $1,000 monthly for ongoing avatar content, posting, and system maintenance.; label: Agency Stack Guide newsletter; low: 297; high: 297; notes: $297 managed newsletter example. Send a test to yourself and check custom fields and links before client distribution.; label: Malinowski design example; low: 5000; high: 5000; notes: $5,000 monthly design service with one request at a time and a stated 48-hour completion period per request.
